answer_1.quote: We propose a new method, DemoGen, to generate the necessary supports which show different instructions and targets of which the query instruction requires a composition of.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are support instructions and corresponding action sequences (demonstrations) for in-context learning in grounded language tasks, conditioned on the environment state and query instruction.

answer_2.quote: Success happens when the agent performs the expected sequence of actions exactly.

answer_3.quote: We used commercial large language models to generate paraphrases of the inputs to test the scalability of our method to natural language data in Section 4.1.
